status: marker-only annotation reviewed and saved before new PDE5A summaries
evidence: Within each experiment all four predefined mural markers have their largest cluster mean in the selected cluster; scaled composite score=1. Both RGS5 and ACTA2 rank first. AIF1/PTPRC are absent or low; EMCN/VWF and RPE65/BEST1 do not dominate these clusters.
boundary: The original experiments use different cluster namespaces. A single global cluster1 combines mural-like cells from enriched donors with unrelated cells from unenriched donors. Do not reuse that pooled label. No SMC/pericyte split is made.
source: marker_cluster_means_by_experiment.csv and provisional_mural_annotation_marker_only.csv; original-paper numeric annotations were not used to select on PDE5A
